Ports

Every app Hyaline is ported to. Each port ships Hyaline Dark and Hyaline Light from the same palette, with a step-by-step install guide. Not every app can do glass, so each port says how far it gets:

  • Tier 1, Full glass: palette, translucency, and blur
  • Tier 2, Flat: full palette on solid surfaces
  • Tier 3, Minimal: background, accent, and status colors

No port list found. Build the site with pwsh build/site.ps1 and open _site/ports/, or browse the Ports folder on GitHub.
